name: Evaporating Word
description: One word in a sentence that evaporates letter by letter and condenses into the next.

props.name: words
props.description: Words shown in turn. Screen readers hear all of them, separated by commas.

props.name: interval
props.description: Milliseconds each word stays. The cycle pauses while the word is off screen, and holds the first word under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the wrapping span, an inline block. Font, size and colour are inherited. Other span props are passed through.
